bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears dominated the defending Super Bowl champion Seattle Seahawks 34-17 on Monday Night Football, with D'Andre Swift rushing for three second-half touchdowns to improve to 6-2 on the season. Newly acquired defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons made an immediate impact in his Bears debut, getting a huge sack in Chicago en route to the win over the Seahawks , fueling talk that the Bears could be legitimate Super Bowl contenders.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The biggest story continues to be linebacker Jack Campbell's injury scare, as he suffered an injury while making a tackle on the first play of the fourth quarter in Detroit's 19-15 victory over the Minnesota Vikings and was taken to a local hospital to be evaluated for a neck injury. packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers added quarterback depth by signing three players, including EDGE D.J. Johnson, QB Cam Miller, and S John Saunders Jr., to the practice squad while releasing S Kahlef Hailassie, as announced by general manager Brian Gutekunst on Tuesday.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Vikings dropped their first game of the season in a 19-15 loss to the Detroit Lions, with offensive struggles continuing to raise questions about Kyler Murray's inaccuracy and the growing pains that have come with signing him this offseason . In roster moves, the Vikings waived guard Trevor Keegan on November 3 and released tight end Bryson Nesbit from the practice squad , as the team weighs its options ahead of next week's NFL trade deadline.
